data.name: Settings_HotkeyHelp
data.value: Select modifiers, then focus the key box and press one key.

data.name: Settings_ChooseShortcut
data.value: Choose at least one modifier and one key.

data.name: Window_Unavailable
data.value: The selected window is no longer available.

data.name: Window_UnavailableRetry
data.value: The selected window is no longer available. Try again.

data.name: Window_RestoreFailed
data.value: The selected window could not be restored.

data.name: Window_ActivateFailed
data.value: Windows did not allow or complete activation of the selected window.

data.name: Help_OpeningText
data.value: Use the global hotkey to show or hide WindowDeck. The default shortcut is Win + `. You can change it in Settings. You can also left-click the tray icon to show or hide WindowDeck.

data.name: Help_FindingText
data.value: Type in Search windows to filter by application or visible window/document title. Windows can be grouped by application. The Screen column shows which screen contains each window, for example [ 1 ], [ 2 ], [ 3 ], and so on.

data.name: Help_ActionsText
data.value: Click a title or row to activate that exact window. The — button minimizes that window. The × button sends one normal close request to that exact window; the application may still show its usual Save, Don't Save, or Cancel dialog.

data.name: Help_TrayText
data.value: WindowDeck's X button and Esc hide the flyout. WindowDeck keeps running in the tray. To shut down the application, use Tray > Exit.

data.name: Help_SettingsText
data.value: Settings includes Start with Windows, Start minimized to tray, the configurable global hotkey, grouping by application, application icons, screen numbers, minimized windows, Appearance (System, Light, or Dark), and Language (System, English, or Polski).

data.name: About_Description
data.value: A lightweight Windows utility for quickly finding and switching between open windows.

data.name: About_Source
data.value: Source code is included in the WindowDeck repository.

data.name: Message_InvalidSettings
data.value: WindowDeck could not read settings.json and is using safe defaults. Saving Settings will replace the invalid file.

data.name: Message_HotkeyUnavailable

data.name: Message_ShortcutUnavailable
data.value: That shortcut is unavailable. The previous shortcut remains active.
